releases.new: Use the new Map datatype, which supports a get operation for looking up values by key.
releases.breaking: Built-in Dask support moved to the narwhals-dask plugin and is deprecated; install the plugin to keep using Dask.

releases.new: Use plugins for more IO and from_* functions, so third-party backends can read and build data frames.
releases.breaking: Results changed: rename now consistently raises DuplicateError, and var/std, mode, arg_min and arg_max return different values in some cases; update any code catching old errors.

releases.new: Cast whole DataFrames or LazyFrames to new dtypes using the new cast method.
releases.breaking: Floor division by zero on pandas-like backends now returns null, and str.slice with negative length or str.zfill with negative width now raises; check code relying on old results.
